sloka: देवदेवं ब्रुवाणं तं रक्ताम्बुरुहलोचनम् ।शक्त्या बिभेद सङ्क्रुद्धो राक्षसेन्द्रो भुजान्तरे ।। ७.८.९ ॥
transliteration: devadevaṁ bruvāṇaṁ taṁ raktāmburuhalocanam ।śaktyā bibheda saṅkruddho rākṣasendro bhujāntare ।। 7.8.9 ॥

translations.english: The greatly enraged king of Rakshasas pierced the chest of the god of gods, whose eyes were like red lotuses, with a spear as he was speaking.
